title: Pure Stardust and Majestic
summary: The Stardust Dragon side of the Synchro family: Stardust cards, the Majestic cards that build on Stardust Dragon, and untagged Synchros. The Majestic page opens this same list, and the Junk/Synchron engine stays on the Junk list. Normal Summon Stardust Trail, then Stardust Synchron tributes it to summon itself and searches a Spell/Trap that mentions Stardust Dragon. The tribute brings Trail back from the GY, and the two make a Level 8. Stardust Dragon - Victim Sanctuary, the newest card (2026), tributes itself to negate a response to your play. Later, once a monster has been tributed that turn, it banishes itself from the GY to summon another Stardust Synchro. Accel Synchro Stardust Dragon revives a small Tuner, then tributes itself in either Main Phase for Stardust Dragon and a second Synchro Summon. Arrive in Light puts Converging Wills Dragon on top of the Deck and draws it, and Stardust Wurm brings back two Level 1 LIGHT Dragons. With Majestic Dragon and Stardust Dragon, that climbs into Majestic Star Dragon and Shooting Majestic Star Dragon. Stardust Synchron locks the Extra Deck to Synchros, so it holds only Synchro Monsters.
main: Stardust Synchron
Tuner: tributes a monster to summon itself; searches a Stardust Dragon Spell/Trap.
Stardust Trail
Returns from the hand or GY on any tribute; leaves a Stardust Token as material.
Stardust Wurm
Joins a Level 8 Dragon Synchro; tributes itself for two Level 1 LIGHT Dragons.
Converging Wills Dragon
Majestic Tuner: summons itself when drawn; with a Level 8+ Dragon Synchro out, calls a Level 1 Dragon.
Majestic Dragon
Tuner for the Majestic Synchros only.
Satellite Synchron
Allowed Tuner: joins when a monster is summoned from your GY; becomes Level 4.
Stardust Xiaolong
Level 1 LIGHT Dragon: returns when you Synchro Summon Stardust Dragon.
Arrive in Light
Puts a Level 1 Dragon on top of the Deck; draws or summons a Tuner on Synchro Summons.
Stardust Illumination
Mills or summons a Stardust monster; shifts a Stardust's Level by 1.
Majestic Absorption
Gives Stardust Dragon an equip steal, a direct attack or burn.
Synchro Chase
Untagged: no responses to Stardust effects; revives a Synchro material.
Majestic Mirage
Revives, banishes or halves damage when your Stardust card leaves.
Starlight Road
Untagged: negates a multi-card wipe and summons Stardust Dragon.
extra: Newest Level 8: tributes itself to negate a response; banishes from the GY for another Stardust.

Level 8: tributes itself to negate a destruction effect, then returns.
Majestic Level 11: negates a monster and banishes a card on their turn.
Majestic Level 10 from Majestic Dragon and Stardust Dragon: wipes their field.
Level 8: protects a card once per turn.
Untagged Level 10 from Coral Dragon and Stardust Dragon: negates destruction.
Untagged Level 10: destroys a card per Synchro in the GY; revives three.
Untagged Level 8 over a Synchro: negates and destroys a monster.
Untagged Synchro Tuner: destroys a card; draws when it leaves.
Untagged Level 9: bounces up to three cards.

allow.Satellite Synchron: Second Tuner for the Stardust line; it names Stardust Synchros and joins when Trail returns from the GY.

exclude.Majestic Red Dragon: Needs Red Dragon Archfiend, which belongs to that list.
exclude.Synchro Fellowship: Must also add Junk Synchron, so it stays on the Junk list.
